summary.name: ChatGPT Millionaire AI
summary.one_liner: A browser tool that turns one photo of a person or pet into a ~10–13 second 9:16 meme video remaking the viral "Get a job." ChatGPT millionaire skit.
use_cases: Make a funny Get a job meme short from your own selfie
Create a pet version of the millionaire skit
Produce a vertical clip for TikTok, Reels, or Shorts
Make a one-off comedy video without editing software
summary.what_it_does: The tool takes one clear photo of a person (18+) or a pet and generates a roughly 10–13 second vertical 9:16 MP4 that remakes the viral skit where someone asks how to become a millionaire in 30 days and reacts with "Get a job." The output includes original AI ambient audio and no watermark, per the page. The flow runs entirely in the browser: upload a photo, press Generate (price shown first), then download or share the file. Renders are priced in credits, with 720p renders costing 500 credits and 480p renders costing 375 credits. The page says failed render starts return credits automatically.
notable: Single-photo flow with no prompt writing or editing app needed
Output is 9:16 MP4 with no watermark, sized for TikTok, Reels and Shorts
Pay-once credit packs with no subscription; Stripe checkout and no account required
Independent fan tool, explicitly not affiliated with OpenAI or ChatGPT
caveats: Paid only: from $8.88 for one 720p video, with 3-pack ($16.99) and 10-pack ($29.90) options
Input must be a photo of yourself (18+), a consenting friend, or your own pet; the page says no celebrities or strangers
Render download links expire, so the MP4 must be saved promptly
